new_result.statement: For Q=2 Z1 Z3+Z2^2 in the defined banked Parseval family, ||p_Q||_infinity <= 16 e^(3/4) < 33.873; same for -Q.
new_result.mechanism: group disjoint original coordinates into four independent normalized bank sums; condition two banks; the remaining X0,Y++,Y+- give a physical 3x3 block with det=-c/4 and positive majority pivot (1+2sqrt(1-c))/4; rescale bank density caps <=sqrt(e) and apply account03/B11.
new_result.rank_two_control: Deleting Z2^2 makes the bank 3x3 determinant vanish and leaves a saddle with logarithmic density singularity for the Gaussian control. Restoring Z2^2 creates |det B|=c/4 and supplies the Abel square-root smoothing direction.
new_result.counterexample_scope: The same family refutes the proof mechanism that macroscopic heavy-row export forces one uniformly good original-coordinate 3x3 principal triple: each local determinant/pivot scale tends to zero while total heavy-triple determinant mass and heavy cross energy both stay c. This is not a QFORM counterexample.
